title: Q-ASHBY-index: The journal's keyword index and Other Index are not ingested as metadata; the two DAMS categories and the archive's copyright page were not read
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** SECOND-LOOP-KERNEL-1 merged (PR 2629); work record issue 2620
**Done check:** cmd:git ls-files --error-unmatch seed/autonomy/ashby-index.json
**Closing probe:** `node --test seed/worker/test/secondloop.test.js seed/worker/test/organization.test.js` passes with a test that exercises it, and `git ls-files --error-unmatch seed/autonomy/ashby-index.json` exits 0
**Prediction:** ashby_concepts_implemented >= 18 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** copying any text or image from ashby.info; blind random search
**Status:** closed

Problem: The journal's keyword index and Other Index are not ingested as metadata; the two DAMS categories and the archive's copyright page were not read. Build: a metadata-only crawler (page numbers and addresses, one request per two seconds, nothing stored verbatim) writing seed/autonomy/ashby-index.json.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T10:57:40Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
